✨ A new date for our Starry Night Painting Workshop! 🌙🎨

Our workshop has been rescheduled to Saturday, 5th September, giving you another chance to join us for a creative afternoon inspired by Vincent van Gogh’s iconic The Starry Night.

No prior painting experience is required—just come along and learn to paint your own version step by step. All materials will be provided!

📅 Saturday, 5th September
🕑 2 PM – 5 PM
📍 TW Den, F-7 Markaz
💰 Rs. 5,000 (all materials included)
